description: Search European companies by name, partial name, or address. Powered by the autocomplete index for typo-tolerance + 12ms p95. Returns ranked hits with IČO, name, address, NACE code, legal form, status, and country. Use this for fuzzy 'find a company called …' queries before drilling into details with lookup_company or get_company_details. Coverage: 23 live markets (FR, GB, RO, SK, UA, GR, CZ, BE, NO, IE, FI, CH, PL, AT, CY, LT, LV, EE, SI, ES, IT, NL, HR).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code filter (e.g. 'SK', 'CZ', 'AT'). Case-insensitive.

q.description: Search query (company name, partial name, address, IČO)

name: search_companies
title: Search companies
